about_the_role: An entry-level data science role on a three-person analytics team. You will get unusually broad exposure, from writing the extraction query to presenting the result.
responsibilities: Write SQL to extract and aggregate data from the company data warehouse.
Clean and prepare datasets for analysis using Pandas.
Build baseline models and compare them against simple heuristics.
Produce weekly reporting and investigate anomalies in key metrics.
Document every analysis so it can be reproduced by someone else.
required_skills: Working knowledge of Python and the Pandas library.
Ability to write correct SQL queries against relational databases.
Undergraduate-level Statistics including probability and significance testing.
Basic Machine Learning understanding, including train/test splitting and overfitting.
Data Visualization for communicating results clearly.
preferred_skills: Exposure to scikit-learn for model building.
Familiarity with Excel for quick stakeholder-facing analysis.
Experience with Data Warehousing tools such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
Interest in ETL pipelines and data engineering fundamentals.
Any experience with Model Evaluation techniques such as cross-validation.
qualifications: Final-year student or recent graduate in a quantitative discipline.
A project where you analysed a dataset you sourced yourself.
